citation: Watkins J, Simpson A, Betts JA et al. (2020). Galactose Ingested with a High-Fat Beverage Increases Postprandial Lipemia Compared with Glucose but Not Fructose Ingestion in Healthy Men. The Journal of Nutrition 150(7):1765-1772.
protocol: High-fat drinks scaled per kg (0.94 g/kg fat, 0.12 g/kg protein, 0.17 g/kg lactose + 0.75 g/kg of the test sugar): experiment 1 glucose vs galactose; experiment 2 fructose vs galactose. Capillary blood at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240, 300 min.
population: Healthy non-obese men: experiment 1 n=10, experiment 2 n=9 (Table 1).
